description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractThingEvent' for events associated with 'Things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles event metadata, JSON serialization, and common properties shared by all specific event types.

classes.name: AbstractThingEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic event related to a 'Thing' in Eclipse Ditto, providing common properties and JSON serialization logic.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the associated Thing.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the Thing at the time of the event.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp of the event.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the metadata associated with the event.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest string for the event, defaulting to its type.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event into a JSON object according to a schema version and predicate.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Abstract method to append event-specific payload to the JSON builder.
